items.t: Four-speed automatic slips, flares or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace four-speed automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report about $2,500 on average. Heavy-duty 4L80-E units cost more.

items.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the transmission
items.job: Replace radiator and rebuild or replace transmission
items.note: Owners report about $3,500. If caught very early, a radiator and fluid flush alone may be enough.

items.t: Engine leaks coolant from intake manifold gaskets
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Van engine access through the doghouse adds time.

items.t: Misfires from the central 'spider' fuel injector
Fuel pump wears out and van won't start
items.note: Long-wheelbase vans with bigger tanks take longer.

items.t: Transmission fluid leaks
items.job: Replace leaking cooler line, pan gasket or seal
items.note: Owners who waited until the transmission was damaged reported about $2,000.

items.t: 4.3L V6 uses too much oil
items.job: Oil consumption diagnosis and PCV service
items.note: Ring replacement, if needed, costs much more.

items.t: Ticking from broken exhaust manifold bolts
items.job: Extract broken bolts, replace manifold bolts and gasket

items.t: Duramax diesel runs hot under load
items.job: Replace fan clutch and clean radiator and intercooler

items.t: Diesel particulate filter clogs
items.job: Clean diesel particulate filter and change oil

items.t: Diesel high-pressure fuel pump can fail and contaminate the fuel system
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump, injectors, lines and flush fuel system
items.note: If caught before debris spreads, only the pump may need replacing.

items.t: Eight-speed automatic shifts harshly or slips
items.job: Replace transmission valve body or spacer plate kit
items.note: Software updates are cheaper; a full replacement costs far more.

items.t: 2.8L diesel turbo whines or leaks oil at the ducts
items.job: Tighten duct clamp or replace turbocharger
items.note: The low end is just a clamp; turbo replacement is the high end.

items.t: Fuel pump control module fails and engine stalls or won't shut off
items.job: Replace fuel pump power control module
items.note: Covered for 8 years/80,000 miles under the federal emissions warranty.

items.note: Free at a GMC dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Usually covered under the new-vehicle warranty.
